overview_description.description: Knownwell provides an AI-powered platform for commercial intelligence, enabling businesses to integrate data from their internal systems, natural communications, and public information into actionable insights. It helps organizations monitor client portfolio health, detect early risk signals for churn, surface growth opportunities, and streamline decision-making by unifying disparate data sources into a single dashboard. Its services include automated health scoring of clients, real-time alerts on engagement or risk changes, and data visualization tools tailored for professional services firms. The platform supports seamless integration with existing tech stacks and emphasizes turning raw communications and external signals into strategic intelligence for client retention and growth.
